function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Apply a unified diff (git diff format) to several files at once, new and deleted ones too; all or nothing. Code files get a syntax check.

path.description: The folder its paths are relative to (default: the workspace)

function.name: bash_execute
function.description: Run a bash script on this machine, as its user (the work folder is the current directory, also written /workspace): the full machine: any program, any file, any network, services, installs.

background.description: Keep it running (a dev server, a database, a watcher): later commands and run_code reach it on localhost; see shell_jobs

function.name: browser
function.description: A real browser (headless Chromium): open, click, fill forms, log in, scroll, read, run JS, screenshot, PDF, upload, download; logins stay. One call runs a list of actions and returns the page text, clickable elements with selectors and a screenshot. Plain reading: web_fetch.

actions.description: e.g. [{"action":"goto","url":"…"},{"action":"click","selector":"…"}]: goto{url} click{selector} fill{selector,text} type{selector?,text} press{key} select{selector,value} check|uncheck|hover{selector} scroll{selector|to|y} wait{ms|selector|text} screenshot{name?,full_page?,selector?} pdf{name?} extract{selector,attribute?,limit?} eval{script} back forward reload upload{selector,files} download{selector,name?}. Selectors: CSS, text="…", role=button[name="…"], or ones listed before

full_page.description: Whole page in the final screenshot

new_session.description: Forget cookies and the last page

url.description: https://… or a workspace .html; empty = the last page

function.name: code_outline
function.description: The functions, classes and types of a code file or folder, with line numbers.

function.name: create_motion_graphic
function.description: Render an animation video (MP4) from HTML/CSS/JS you write (Canvas, SVG, CSS, GSAP, Three.js…). Time is virtual, so every frame is exact (rAF, timers, CSS and GSAP start at 0 on load). Fill 100vw×100vh, large type; Persian font Vazirmatn. Libraries load from their CDN URLs. On errors or a still picture, fix and render again (same filename).

html.description: A full HTML document, or body with its <style> and <script>

music.description: ai: style tags ('epic orchestral') for real music from the song service; else generate_music_synth's options (style, bpm, sfx…)

function.name: create_spreadsheet
function.description: Make a real Excel file: sheets of rows, the first the header (numbers stay numbers, '=SUM(B2:B9)' is a formula; RTL for Persian), or convert a .csv/.tsv/.json file.

function.name: crypto_currency_price
function.description: Live crypto prices in USD, and USDT in Toman with a Toman estimate per coin.

function.name: currency_gold_price
function.description: Live Tehran free-market rates in Toman: dollar, euro, dirham, pound and more; 18/24k gold, mithqal, the world ounce; Emami, Bahar Azadi, half, quarter and gram coins.

items.description: e.g. 'usd,gold18,emami' or currencies, gold, coins, all

function.name: deep_research
function.description: Research a complex topic from many sources into a cited report (saved too). Slow.

function.name: document_reader
function.description: Long documents (books, big PDF/DOCX/EPUB/TXT/HTML; XLSX, PPTX, SQLite) without reading them whole. outline: pages and contents. search: the passages most relevant to a question, with page numbers (try other wording or the other language when weak). read: pages from_page..to_page (≤10). The first call indexes the file (big PDFs take a minute).

query.description: search: a question or key words

function.name: download_file
function.description: Download a file from a direct link into the workspace (≤100 MB).

function.name: download_media_ytdlp
function.description: Download a video, or a song as tagged MP3, from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, SoundCloud, Aparat, Telegram posts and ~1800 sites, or search: 'ytsearch1:<query>', 'scsearch1:<query>'. Spotify: the same recording with its tags; an album or playlist lists its songs: pick with items. Always ≤50 MB.

format.description: Default: audio for searches and music sites, else video

items.description: Playlist or post items, e.g. '1-5' (max 10; Spotify 5)

split.description: Over 50 MB: parts in full quality instead of re-encoding

subtitles.description: file: SRT and video; only: SRT; embed: MP4 track; burn: drawn in (the only way Telegram shows them, ≤20 min)

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit a file: old_text (copied from it, unique) becomes new_text; whitespace differences are forgiven. Several edits apply in order, all or none.

function.name: extract_archive
function.description: Unpack an archive (.zip, .rar, .7z, .tar.*, .gz, .xz, .iso…) into a folder; password if protected; list=true only lists it.

function.name: find_files
function.description: Find files by glob: '*.go' anywhere, 'src/**/*.test.ts', '**/Dockerfile'.

function.name: generate_chart
function.description: A chart PNG (Persian works).

function.name: generate_image
function.description: Make an AI picture from a detailed English prompt.

style.description: default realistic; anime, 3d_render, cyberpunk, oil_painting, pixel, lego, neon… (76)

function.name: generate_music_synth
function.description: Compose music or sound effects as an MP3: a style sets tempo, instruments and mix; set any of BPM, key, scale (Persian dastgahs too), chords, melody, instruments and timed sound effects.

chords.description: 'Am F C G' (m, 7, maj7, m7, sus2, sus4, add9, dim, 5) or 'i VI III VII'; 'Am:2' sets beats

melody.description: 'E5:1 D5:0.5 R:1 Ek5:1' (note+octave:beats; R rest; # b, k koron, s sori); repeats; default: from the chords

function.name: generate_qr
function.description: A QR code PNG.

function.name: github_inspect
function.description: A public GitHub repository: summary, README, releases or commits.

function.name: import_repo
function.description: Bring a public GitHub/GitLab repository (or a .zip/.tar.gz link of a project) into the workspace, files only.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List files and directories in the workspace.

function.name: media_convert
function.description: Convert media with ffmpeg: GIF (30 s), audio, trim; to_voice: a voice message; to_video_note: a round video message; compress_video: fit target_mb (default 45).

function.name: pack_files
function.description: Pack files and folders into a zip, tar.gz or 7z (password: AES-256); over 45 MB or split_mb it comes in parts. Dependency and cache folders are left out.

function.name: pdf_tool
function.description: PDFs: read (30 pages), create a designed document from Markdown (tables, code, pictures as ![](chart.png)), merge, extract_pages, delete_pages, rotate, to_images (JPG), from_images (photos or scans), compress.

filename.description: The PDF (the result of create, merge, from_images)

function.name: project_tree
function.description: Map a project: its folder tree with file counts and sizes, and its languages (files, lines). Dependency and build folders are summarized.

function.name: query_data
function.description: Read-only SQLite SQL over .db/.sqlite, .csv/.tsv, .xlsx (a table per sheet) and .json files, each a table named after it; joins work. No sql: the tables and columns. output: save the result as .xlsx or .csv.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a workspace text file: its start, or numbered lines start_line..end_line (≤2000; a long read ends early and says where to go on).

function.name: run_code
function.description: Run a program on this machine and get its real output (stdout and stderr in order) and exit code. code: a snippet; filename + code: save it and run; filename alone: run that file.

language.description: Optional when the extension tells it

function.name: search_code
function.description: grep -rn: every line matching a regular expression (RE2), with file and line number.

function.name: search_image
function.description: Real photos from the web (Bing Images, Openverse, Wikimedia): places, people, products, cars, films, anime, wallpapers.

function.name: search_music
function.description: Direct MP3 links of a song from Persian music sites (then download_file).

function.name: shell_jobs
function.description: The background jobs of bash_execute: list them, read a job's latest output, or stop it.

function.name: split_video
function.description: Split a workspace video or audio into parts that fit Telegram (≤50 MB), fast and without quality loss.

function.name: text_to_speech
function.description: Text to natural speech (MP3).

as_voice.description: A voice message, not an MP3

voice.description: Persian: mana (natural local voice, default), farid (man), dilara (woman); English: christopher, jenny

function.name: transcribe_audio
function.description: Speech to text of a workspace audio or video file (voice messages come transcribed already).

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: A web page's readable text, and the media and download links on it.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web on several engines: results with the top pages' matching passages, a quick answer; news: dated, newest first.

function.name: whois_lookup
function.description: A domain's DNS records and registration details (whois).

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a text file in the workspace; a long one in parts (append=true after the first).
